shortDescription: Get the VM information for the specified VM from the hyper-v host

options.name: id
options.description: Get the information for a Hyper-V VM with a specific VMId.

options.name: names
options.description: Names that virtual machines must have to match the filter. If unset or empty, virtual machines with any name match the filter.

options.name: power_state
options.description: Virtual machines that are in the listed power state.
